title: Police Blotter: 7 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 7 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Nov. 8–9, 2026 — including alleged DWI, family-violence assault, terroristic threats, criminal trespass, and a dangerous-drug possession charge, plus immigration and out-of-county holds. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Seven people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Sunday, November 8, and Monday, November 9, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

DE ALBA, JOSE DEJESUS

DE ALBA, JOSE DEJESUS was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 9:02 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of terroristic threat causing fear of imminent serious bodily injury, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,000.

CASTILLO-LOPEZ, CARLOS ISRAEL

CASTILLO-LOPEZ, CARLOS ISRAEL was arrested on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 11:42 p.m. on an alleged charge of possession of a dangerous drug, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. He is also held on an immigration hold by Customs and Border Protection. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

CHAVEZ, CESAR ISAAC

CHAVEZ, CESAR ISAAC was arrested on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 2:18 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500.

RIOS, FRANK

RIOS, FRANK was arrested on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 7:54 a.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on an alleged charge of terroristic threat against a family or household member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000.

LARA, MARCO ANTONIO, JR

LARA, MARCO ANTONIO, JR was arrested on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 2:14 p.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

RANGEL, ANGEL JASIEL

RANGEL, ANGEL JASIEL was arrested on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 3:09 p.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

ACOSTA, VICTOR MANUEL

ACOSTA, VICTOR MANUEL was arrested on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $4,500. He is also held on an out-of-county/state hold. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
